text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: …Hi, Trainer. Let's have a good session.
choice_data_list: You don't seem like yourself today.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Well… I gave a student that was reading comics in class a warning today.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But then she started crying. I guess I was too loud and I scared her… Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: If I can't consider other people's feelings, I'm not fit to be head of the disciplinary committee… I'm so ashamed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory is feeling down after unintentionally upsetting another student.
